now.title: Agent Carter S2#10
now.text: Howard Stark returns to Los Angeles to help Peggy Carter stop Whitney Frost and her Zero Matter. As Frost chases the team from the waste facility, Howard and Edwin Jarvis run her down with a car.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Zero Matter villain Howard runs down with a car.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Inventor who runs Whitney down with a car alongside Jarvis.

proposed.text: Howard Stark returns to Los Angeles to help Peggy Carter stop Whitney Frost. Edwin Jarvis runs Frost down with the car Howard rides in, and Howard later fires the gamma cannon that strips her of the Zero Matter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Zero Matter villain Howard strips of her powers with the gamma cannon.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Inventor whose gamma cannon strips Whitney of her Zero Matter.

changes.evidence: In Hollywood Ending (Agent Carter S2#10), Frost is hit by a car driven by Edwin Jarvis with Howard Stark as passenger; at the studio lot Stark fires the gamma cannon at Frost and she loses all her Zero Matter. The card line has Howard running her down, but Jarvis is the driver.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#10
now.text: Worried about Frost's obsession with the rift, Manfredi walks in on Stark, Peggy and Wilkes at dinner and agrees to help them, distracting Frost while they steal her plans.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Frost's partner, who turns against her and helps Wilkes and Peggy stop her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist Manfredi ends up helping against Frost.

proposed.text: Worried about Frost's obsession with the rift, Manfredi is brought in at gunpoint by Jarvis while Stark, Peggy and Wilkes eat a late breakfast, and he agrees to help them by distracting Frost while they steal her plans.

changes.evidence: In Hollywood Ending (Agent Carter S2#10), Stark, Carter and Wilkes are eating a late breakfast at the Stark mansion when Jarvis brings Manfredi in at gunpoint; he agrees to distract Frost so they can photograph her Rift Generator plans. It is breakfast, not dinner, and he does not walk in on his own.
